scope: Extend the P6-G standalone ATTRIB/SEQEND whole-write transaction matrix to the oldest DXF writer target accepted by dxfRW::write.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during the test
source.profile: One INSERT with two non-MTEXT ATTRIB children, distinct handles, tags, text and geometry; AC1014 ASCII and Binary DXF output.

implementation.change: Extended the transaction selector to AC1014 and retained the already-qualified AC1015, AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024 profiles.
implementation.method: Inject std::bad_alloc at every allocation reached by a successful whole dxfRW::write. Verify failure, prior destination preservation, unchanged caller INSERT/ATTRIB fields, no staged output, same-codec byte-identical retry, and fresh typed readback.

validation.focusedCTest: ctest --test-dir build -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_legacy_attributed_insert_allocation_transaction$' --output-on-failure: PASS 1/1 in 6.88 seconds across AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024.
validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check on implementation, plan and receipt paths

observations: AC1012 was probed but dxfRW::write refused the target with DRW::BAD_VERSION (error index 3) before the entity callback; AC1012 is not included in this writer transaction matrix.
limitations: Generated AC1014 transport/transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native consumer behavior are not qualified.
Only one INSERT with two standalone ATTRIB children is covered; other compound-record field profiles remain in P6-G inventory.
